name: Bekko CPU 方案 / Bekko CPU plan
description: 应用已固定来源的 Bekko 嵌入模型与 CPU 运行预算，模型文件由独立模型管理流程取得。 / Apply the pinned Bekko embedding model and CPU budgets; model acquisition remains separate.
changelog:
## 中文
1.1：CPU线程预算由2改为1，适合与编辑工作并行；保持模型固定来源、修订、内存与超时，不包含权重。
## English
1.1: Use one CPU thread instead of two while editing alongside inference. Keep the pinned model source, revision, memory and timeout; no weights are included.
